name: Blackboard Learn
hint: A REST application’s key and secret from developer.blackboard.com, enabled by your Learn admin under REST API Integrations.

endpoints.name: list_courses
endpoints.description: Lists courses, filtered by name, course ID or term.

notes.name: Search for courses with name properties that contain this value. **Since**: 3100.0.0
notes.courseId: Search for courses with courseId properties that contain this value. **Since**: 3100.0.0
notes.termId: Search for courses with this termId. This may optionally be the term's externalId using the syntax "externalId:spring2015". **Since**: 3100.0.0
notes.limit: The maximum number of results to be returned. There may be less if the query returned less than the maximum.
notes.offset: The number of rows to skip before beginning to return rows. An offset of 0 is the same as omitting the offset parameter.
notes.sort: Properties to sort by. This is a comma-delimited list of JSON properties, with an optional "(desc)" suffix to request a descending sort for that property. e.g. "name(desc),created" Supported fields are: - courseId - name - externalId - created - modified **Since**: 3400.8.0

endpoints.name: get_course
endpoints.description: Returns one course. Its ID may be written courseId:<id> or externalId:<id>.

notes.courseId: The course or organization ID. This may be the primary ID, or any of the secondary IDs prefixed with the ID type. | ID type | Example | |------------|---------------------------------------| | primary | _123_1 | | externalId | externalId:math101 | | courseId | courseId:math101 | | uuid | uuid:915c75
